text: The existing suite passes: 106 tests. Targeted checks also pass for read-only attributes, iteration, tuple comparisons, bumps, replacements, and CLI success/error paths. I also found short-tuple comparisons in the existing documentation and added zero defaults for omitted minor and patch components to support those examples.

arguments.command:
cat >> docs/usage.rst <<'EOF'

VersionInfo values
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

The public version components are read-only. Iterate over a version to get
``major``, ``minor``, ``patch``, ``prerelease``, and ``build`` in that order.
Bump and replacement methods return new instances without changing the original:

.. code-block:: python

    >>> version = VersionInfo.parse('1.2.3-rc.1+build.4')
    >>> tuple(version)
    (1, 2, 3, 'rc.1', 'build.4')
    >>> str(version.bump_minor())
    '1.3.0'
    >>> str(version.replace(patch=7, prerelease=None))
    '1.2.7+build.4'
    >>> semver.replace('1.2.3', major=2)
    '2.2.3'

Command-line interface
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

The ``pysemver`` argument parser is also available through ``python -m semver``:

.. code-block:: console

    $ python -m semver compare 1.0.0 2.0.0
    -1
    $ python -m semver bump patch 1.2.3
    1.2.4
    $ python -m semver check 1.2.3

``check`` exits successfully for valid semantic versions. Invalid versions
produce an error on standard error and a nonzero exit status. Use ``--help``
for the available commands and arguments.
EOF
python -m pytest -q
python -m doctest semver.py docs/usage.rst
